_schema: Investor-relations report sources, keyed by ticker. Only status "live" entries are fetched. Every other status is a TODO that the owner must resolve. The fetcher uses the company's own domains only (allowed_hosts), obeys robots.txt for each host, and writes PDFs to the document vault (never Git, never a database). See engines/ir_fetcher.py.
_verified_on: 2026-11-11 (one plain GET per company, plus robots.txt; see the notes on each entry)
